lastResponse.text: You can keep this very private. You don’t have to share her story widely. For a minor without ID in Hillsboro, try Safe Place for Youth: 454 South E Washington Street, Hillsboro. You can call 5-0-3, 5-4-2, 2-7-1-7. Backup: 5-0-3, 5-4-2, 2-3-8-9. They serve youth ages 12 to 20 and list required documents as none. Because she may be under active pressure from adults, if risk feels immediate, call nine one one now.
